corrections.reason: Both the printed glyph (which shows the 6th-order left loop of ይ) and Ge'ez syntax (where ማይ is the nominative subject and ሐመሮሙ is the accusative object, rendered in Amharic as መርከባቸውን ውሀ መላው) confirm ማይ.
The printed glyphs clearly show 6th-order ን and ይ (nominative subject of ወኮነ in Luke 8:24: ወኮነ ዛሕን ዓቢይ).
In Luke 8:25 the verb is 3rd person masculine plural ወፈርሁ (translated immediately as ፈሩ), and the image shows ሁ rather than ኀ.
